title: Trithemius Corpus: machine-assisted English translations of Latin texts by or associated with Johannes Trithemius
description: Provisional English translations of 29 Latin texts in 47 catalogue records drawn from 45 digitized sources. The project survey located no prior complete published English translation for 23 texts (41 records from 39 sources). Edition records distinguish machine translation, editorial preparation, human review and automated audit coverage. Earlier machine scores are historical. Latin transcription, source scans, and documented corrections support verification of individual passages.
notes: CC BY 4.0 covers the corpus arrangement, documentation and project code. Latin source texts are public domain. Machine translations and generated textual artifacts are released under CC0 1.0. Digitized images and crops retain the holding institution’s terms.
